name: sonic-start-keyboard
step: v12-flight 8: the accessible start screen, driven by the keyboard alone in headless Chrome
note: headless Chrome runs muted (--mute-audio): the audio graph is rendered and measured per channel, nothing is played; how it sounds is not judged here

ariaSnapshot:
- banner:
  - heading "Fly by Sound" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Learn to fly a drone by ear. Everything is said and played as sound, so no screen is needed. A helper can set up your radio, keyboard or gamepad.
- navigation "Fly by Sound sections":
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#sonic-sec-start"
    - listitem:
      - link "Headphones":
        - /url: "#sonic-sec-headphones"
    - listitem:
      - link "Lessons":
        - /url: "#sonic-sec-lessons"
    - listitem:
      - link "Settings":
        - /url: "#sonic-sec-settings"
- main:
  - region "Start":
    - heading "Start" [level=2]
    - group "Start":
      - 'button "Start the course from the beginning Lesson 1 of 28: Headphone check."'
    - group "Path":
      - text: Path
      - radio "Full path Every lesson, step by step." [checked]
      - text: Full path Every lesson, step by step.
      - 'radio "Fast path A short way: hover, walls, a corridor and rings."'
      - text: "Fast path A short way: hover, walls, a corridor and rings."
  - region "Check your headphones":
    - heading "Check your headphones" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Put your headphones on. The side marked L goes on your left ear.
      - listitem: Wired headphones work best. Bluetooth headphones add a delay.
      - listitem: Please switch off Windows Sonic, Atmos and other surround effects. They change the sound.
    - group "Check your headphones":
      - button "Play a sound on the left"
      - button "Play a sound on the right"
      - button "Play a sound behind you"
    - group "Loudness":
      - heading "Loudness" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Keep the volume comfortable. If a sound hurts, take off the headphones and turn the volume down.
      - paragraph: Keep the volume comfortable. If a sound is too loud, turn it down.
  - region "Lessons":
    - heading "Lessons" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Every lesson can be opened directly. The path only recommends an order.
    - region "Ears":
      - heading "Ears" [level=3]
      - list:

checks.name: no AudioContext before the first key
the page title is the product's
the viewport allows zoom (no user-scalable=no, no maximum-scale)
landmarks: one header, one labelled navigation, one main, one footer in the start layer
one h1 (the product), four h2 (start, headphones, lessons, settings)
the h1 has the focus when the screen opens
eight module headings and the loudness heading are h3
28 lessons, each a real button with a name
no div or span made into a button
no id is used twice on the page
the start layer is not inside #ui (an aria-live region): its changes are not read out
the text colours have a contrast of at least 4.5:1 on their background
the accessibility snapshot names the landmarks and headings
value: - paragraph: Learn to fly a drone by ear. Everything is said and played as sound, so no screen is needed. A helper can set up your radio, keyboard or gamepad.

checks.name: no dictionary key shows as text in en, es, pl or ru
no sideways scroll at 1280, 640 and 360 px wide
every stop of Tab is inside the start layer
every stop has a name
the stops follow the document: navigation, start, headphones, lessons, settings, footer
all 28 lessons are reached by Tab, once each
the radio group is one stop (the arrow keys move inside it)
the headphone check has three buttons in the order left, right, behind
the last stop is the footer's last link (no trap: Tab goes on to the browser)

value.name: Leave Fly by Sound and open the simulator

checks.name: Shift+Tab walks back through the same stops, last first

checks.name: Space opens the volume and pitch details and 14 sliders follow (7 sounds, a volume and a pitch each)
an arrow key moves the path to "fast" and it is saved
and back to "full"
the Start button names the first lesson of the path
Space on "Calm mode" turns it on and it is saved
Space on "My screen reader speaks" saves selfVoice off and makes the captions a live region
and off again: the engine speaks, the captions are not live
Space on "Calm mode" again turns it off
the first key made the one AudioContext (the spoken list starts the sound in it)
one AudioContext after the headphone buttons
sound on the left: the left channel is louder (at least 1 dB) and leads (the right channel lags by at least 3 samples)
sound on the right: the right channel is louder (at least 1 dB) and leads (the left channel lags by at least 3 samples)
sound behind: the two channels are level (within 1 dB) and arrive together (within 2 samples)
control: left and right are opposite pictures (balance differs by at least 3 dB, the delays have opposite signs)
Enter on the hover lesson: the page flies that lesson's built-in world (scene lesson-hover-height, the world's digest as its walls)
the start screen is gone from the page and the accessibility tree (hidden and inert)
no Controls screen and no loading card in the way: the keyboard flies at once
still one AudioContext for the whole mode
no pointer event in the whole run: the keyboard did everything
?sonic=<unknown> shows the start screen with a note
checks.value: There is no lesson called no-such-lesson. Choose one from the list.

checks.name: ?sonic=walls-hall offers that lesson first, as the primary button
the pilot's choices and the current lesson are saved in the prefs collection
no console errors and no missing file (but the favicon and the API the dev server does not have)
